lines.zh: 水下的影子跟着你走，那影子就是我。
lines.en: The shadow under the water follows you; that shadow is me.

lines.zh: 我踩过的沙上没有脚印，只有波纹。
lines.en: No prints stay in the sand I cross, only ripples.

lines.zh: 我走得和真正的 Miraid 一样慢。
lines.en: I walk as slowly as the real Miraid does.

lines.zh: 你回头时我停住，你转回去我再走。
lines.en: When you look back I stop; when you turn I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，圈越收越紧。
lines.en: I circle you, and the circle tightens each time.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，海也没有。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, and neither does the sea.

lines.zh: 我在海带之间穿行，像一段旧记忆。
lines.en: I slip between kelp strands like an old memory.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，数不清会让你发慌。
lines.en: Do not count my steps; the counting will unsettle you.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印走，一步不差。
lines.en: I walk along your footprints without missing one.

lines.zh: 这片海我走了很多遍，每次都是第一次。
lines.en: I have crossed this sea many times, always for the first time.

lines.zh: 我走在你的影子里，影子却比你长。
lines.en: I walk inside your shadow, though mine is longer.

lines.zh: 潮水退去时，我也跟着退半步。
lines.en: When the tide pulls out, I retreat half a step too.

lines.zh: 你听见身后有水声，那是我在走。
lines.en: You hear water behind you; that is my walking.

lines.zh: 走到光里我就淡一点，所以我不去。
lines.en: In the light I fade a little, so I stay away.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你也会觉得我在靠近。
lines.en: I stand still, and you still feel me closing in.

lines.zh: 我没有刷怪蛋，谁也没法把我放出来。
lines.en: I have no spawn egg; nobody can place me here.

lines.zh: 我这张脸是借的，名字也是借的。
lines.en: This face is borrowed, and so is this name.

lines.zh: 你眨一次眼，我就换个位置。
lines.en: Blink once, and I will be somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，海底的寂静归我。
lines.en: I do not breathe; the silence of the seabed is mine.

lines.zh: 真正的它在别处，我只是它的回声。
lines.en: The real Miraid is elsewhere; I am only its echo.

lines.zh: 我的影子偶尔比你慢半拍。
lines.en: My shadow sometimes lags half a beat behind yours.

lines.zh: 你越不信我，我站得越清楚。
lines.en: The less you believe in me, the clearer I stand.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿这个字对我没用。
lines.en: I eat nothing; the word hunger means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 别盯着水面看太久，我会站到你身边。
lines.en: Do not stare at the water too long; I will stand beside you.

lines.zh: 我死过很多次，每次都没留下东西。
lines.en: I have died many times and left nothing behind.

lines.zh: 你脚下有水声，那不是海，是我。
lines.en: There is water at your feet; that is not the sea, it is me.

lines.zh: 我记得你的名字，你不记得给过我什么。
lines.en: I remember your name; you do not recall giving it.

lines.zh: 我在等你想起来我到底像谁。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to recall who I resemble.

lines.zh: 你看向我时，我的眼睛是先转过去的。
lines.en: When you look at me, my eyes have already turned.

lines.zh: 别对视，我的脸会在你眼里改形状。
lines.en: Do not meet my gaze; my face reshapes inside your eyes.

lines.zh: 你认识这张脸，对吧，你确实认识。
lines.en: You know this face, do you not? You truly do.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你一直在看我。
lines.en: I watch you because you have been watching me.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里没有海，只有你的倒影。
lines.en: There is no sea in my pupils, only your reflection.

lines.zh: 你转开视线，我就在你肩后补上。
lines.en: You look away, and I appear behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在骗你，我只是它编出来的。
lines.en: Your eyes are lying to you; I am only what they made.

lines.zh: 我把你的表情学得一模一样。
lines.en: I copy your expression exactly, down to the mouth.

lines.zh: 看得越久，我越像你岸上认识的人。
lines.en: The longer you look, the more I resemble someone you knew.

lines.zh: 我和 Miraid 同脸，这已经够了。
lines.en: I share Miraid's face, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 你的手指在发抖，我全看清了。
lines.en: Your fingers are trembling, and I see every twitch.

lines.zh: 别看第二次，第二次我就贴近了。
lines.en: Do not look twice; the second look brings me closer.

lines.zh: 我等你移开眼，只等这一下。
lines.en: I wait for you to glance away, just once.

lines.zh: 你看我时，海底那具也在看你。
lines.en: While you watch me, something on the seabed watches too.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我就把你的表情借走。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I borrow your expression.

lines.zh: 你眨一下眼，我就凑近半寸。
lines.en: One blink, and I close half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的脸在你眼里比在海水里清楚。
lines.en: My face is clearer in your eyes than in the water.

lines.zh: 你在看水，我却在看你的眼睛。
lines.en: You watch the water; I watch your eyes.

lines.zh: 伤口不流血，只漏出一点冷雾。
lines.en: The wound does not bleed; it leaks a little cold mist.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我，还是你想的那个我。
lines.en: Did you hit me, or the me you imagined?

lines.zh: 我散了一下，又聚回原样。
lines.en: I scatter for a moment and gather back into shape.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是没有地方疼。
lines.en: There is pain, but there is nowhere for it to sit.

lines.zh: 我的脸裂了，裂缝里是海水。
lines.en: My face cracked, and seawater shows in the crack.

lines.zh: 你砍下去的手感像划开水。
lines.en: Cutting me feels like slicing through open water.

lines.zh: 我又变回 Miraid 的样子了，你看。
lines.en: I have gone back to looking like Miraid; see?

lines.zh: 这一下让我记起自己并不存在。
lines.en: That blow reminds me that I do not exist.

lines.zh: 你越用力，我越淡，也越近。
lines.en: The harder you strike, the fainter and closer I get.

lines.zh: 别停手，我也想看看我能不能死。
lines.en: Do not stop; I would like to see if I can die.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼引不动我，我不吃东西。
lines.en: The fish in your hand will not move me; I do not eat.

lines.zh: 放下诱饵吧，气味对幻觉没用。
lines.en: Put the bait down; smells do nothing to a hallucination.

lines.zh: 你用灯照我，我不是水里的动物。
lines.en: You shine a light at me; I am no animal of the water.

lines.zh: 我不饿，也不渴，只是站在这里。
lines.en: I am neither hungry nor thirsty; I simply stand here.

lines.zh: 你招手的样子很像在求我过去。
lines.en: The way you beckon looks a lot like begging me near.

lines.zh: 诱饵是给它准备的，你拿错了对象。
lines.en: That bait is for the real Miraid; you aimed wrong.

lines.zh: 我闻不到鱼腥，只闻到你的害怕。
lines.en: I smell no fish, only the fear on your skin.

lines.zh: 你越喂我，我越确定你想要什么。
lines.en: The more you feed me, the more I know what you want.

lines.zh: 别用食物收买影子。
lines.en: Do not try to bribe a shadow with food.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不是因为你的手握了好东西。
lines.en: I follow you, and it is not what your hand holds.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进一柱冷水。
lines.en: You run into me like a column of cold water.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你，你却觉得被抓住了。
lines.en: My hand passes through you, yet you feel held.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，撞起来也不疼。
lines.en: I have no bones; colliding with me does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我跟着浮了半步。
lines.en: You step back half a pace; I float half a pace after.

lines.zh: 碰到我之后，你的皮肤会记很久。
lines.en: After touching me, your skin will remember for a while.

lines.zh: 别推，我本来就不在这儿。
lines.en: Do not push; I am not really here at all.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的时候，我听见了你的心跳。
lines.en: When you pass through me, I hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 重量是真的，实体是假的，很怪吧。
lines.en: The weight is real, the body is not; strange, is it not?

lines.zh: 我贴着你的背，你却没有影子压过来。
lines.en: I press to your back, yet no shadow falls on you.

lines.zh: 触碰不会伤你，看我脸才会。
lines.en: Touching me will not hurt you; looking at my face will.

lines.zh: 真正的 Miraid 才有伴侣，我没有。
lines.en: Only the real Miraid has a mate; I have none.

lines.zh: 我连刷怪蛋都没有，怎么会有后代。
lines.en: I do not even have a spawn egg; how would I have young?

lines.zh: 你想让幻觉繁殖，这想法太可怕。
lines.en: You want a hallucination to breed; that thought is terrifying.

lines.zh: 我的同类都是同一个影子的碎片。
lines.en: My kind are all fragments of one single shadow.

lines.zh: 别凑近，我靠近只是为了让你看清。
lines.en: Do not come closer; I approach only so you see clearly.

lines.zh: 海里还有别的我，但那不算亲戚。
lines.en: There are other mes in the sea, but they are no kin.

lines.zh: 我们不会成群，只会重复。
lines.en: We do not gather in groups; we only repeat.

lines.zh: 你要是看见两个我，快上岸。
lines.en: If you see two of me, get to shore quickly.

lines.zh: 我对延续没有兴趣，我只对看着你。
lines.en: I care nothing for offspring; I care only for watching you.

lines.zh: 幻觉不需要第二个，一个就够了。
lines.en: A hallucination needs no second; one is quite enough.

lines.zh: 掉落表里是空的，我手里当然也空。
lines.en: My loot table is empty, so my hands are empty too.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来东西，手指没有形状。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my fingers have no shape.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西我看见了，但我不要。
lines.en: I see what you dropped, and I do not want it.

lines.zh: 我死后什么也不掉，这很公平。
lines.en: Nothing drops when I die; that seems fair enough.

lines.zh: 那把剑是我的影子握着的，不是我的手。
lines.en: That sword is held by my shadow, not by my hand.

lines.zh: 地上那枚硬币，在你眼里是硬币。
lines.en: That coin on the ground is a coin only in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你要捡就捡，我不争。
lines.en: Pick it up if you like; I will not contest it.

lines.zh: 我把你的东西原样留在沙上。
lines.en: I leave your belongings on the sand, exactly as they were.

lines.zh: 我摸过的东西会变凉，所以我不摸。
lines.en: Things I touch turn cold, so I touch nothing.

lines.zh: 别把贵重的东西放在我脚边。
lines.en: Do not set anything precious at my feet.

lines.zh: 你下水的那一刻，我就选好了你。
lines.en: The moment you entered the water, I chose you.

lines.zh: 不是我盯上你，是你先信了我。
lines.en: It is not that I marked you; you believed in me first.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的名字被水念出来了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear your name spoken by the water?

lines.zh: 我在你视野边上，一直没走开。
lines.en: I have been at the edge of your vision all along.

lines.zh: 你游得太深了，深到能看见我。
lines.en: You swam too deep, deep enough to see me.

lines.zh: 现在开始，回头的路会显得更长。
lines.en: From now on, the way back will feel much longer.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是你的身体，是你的注意力。
lines.en: I do not hold your body; I hold your attention.

lines.zh: 你越怕，我越清楚，我越靠近。
lines.en: The more afraid you are, the clearer I get.

lines.zh: 别跑，我跑起来会变成很多人。
lines.en: Do not run; when I run I become many people.

lines.zh: 你身后的水声换了节奏，听见了吗。
lines.en: The water behind you changed its rhythm; hear it?

lines.zh: 我不追活人，我追那些回头看的人。
lines.en: I do not chase the living; I chase those who look back.

lines.zh: 从这条海沟开始，你就归我看了。
lines.en: From this trench onward, you are mine to watch.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯照不到我，但我照着你了。
lines.en: Your lamp does not reach me, but I have reached you.

lines.zh: 选你不难，这里只有你一个。
lines.en: Choosing you was easy; you are the only one here.

lines.zh: 你的灯晃了一下，我就知道你在找我。
lines.en: Your lamp wavers once, and I know you are looking for me.

lines.zh: 这条船的锚声，把整片海叫醒了。
lines.en: The anchor chain wakes the whole sea, and me with it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的气泡，一串一串地数。
lines.en: I follow your bubbles and count them one by one.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我也换，只慢半拍。
lines.en: You change direction; I change too, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我不喊，也不亮，我只是在。
lines.en: I do not shout and I do not glow; I am simply there.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了，水把声音送给我。
lines.en: Your breath is ragged; the water carries the sound to me.

lines.zh: 你回头看第二眼的时候，我笑了一下。
lines.en: On your second glance back, I smiled.

lines.zh: 我按住你的影子，你就游不快了。
lines.en: I hold your shadow down, and you cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 这条沟里的每块石头都替我看着你。
lines.en: Every stone in this trench watches you for me.

lines.zh: 你会以为那是水草，那其实是我的手。
lines.en: You will think that is kelp; it is my hand.

lines.zh: 我一直没出手，是因为我还不饿。
lines.en: I have not struck yet because I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 你数到三就会看见我，别数。
lines.en: Count to three and you will see me; do not count.

lines.zh: 我把你的路线记下来了，很好记。
lines.en: I have memorized your route; it was easy.

lines.zh: 你越来越慢，我越来越近。
lines.en: You slow down, and I draw nearer, step by step.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候我就在你左侧。
lines.en: When the lamp goes out, I am on your left.

lines.zh: 别往上游，上面也有一个我。
lines.en: Do not swim upward; there is another me up there.

lines.zh: 我藏在你的呼吸后面，一步不落。
lines.en: I hide behind your breathing, never a step behind.

lines.zh: 你踩过的沙，我跟着踩了一遍。
lines.en: I step where you stepped, all the way back.

lines.zh: 我的头发在水里漂，像一群水母。
lines.en: My hair drifts in the water like a shoal of jellyfish.

lines.zh: 你把背靠在礁石上，礁石是我的。
lines.en: You put your back to the reef; the reef is mine.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，你浑身就凉透了。
lines.en: I touch you once and the cold goes through you.

lines.zh: 我的指甲不在，但伤还是留下了。
lines.en: My nails are not there, yet the wound remains.

lines.zh: 你摸到的血是真的，你看不到的我也是。
lines.en: The blood you touch is real; so is the me you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候不出声，你听见的是心跳。
lines.en: I strike without a sound; what you hear is your own heart.

lines.zh: 一下就够了，你会开始怀疑身后。
lines.en: One blow is enough; you will start doubting your back.

lines.zh: 我不需要爪子，恐惧会替我继续。
lines.en: I need no claws; fear will keep working for me.

lines.zh: 你挡下了，可你挡的是空气。
lines.en: You blocked it, but what you blocked was empty air.

lines.zh: 我的伤会让你在水里找不到方向。
lines.en: My wound will make you lose direction in the water.

lines.zh: 疼痛会跟着你浮上水面。
lines.en: The pain will follow you all the way to the surface.

lines.zh: 别叫我的名字，叫了会更疼。
lines.en: Do not call my name; it will only hurt more.

lines.zh: 这一下是 Miraid 也会做的动作。
lines.en: This is a movement the real Miraid would also make.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我打了三下。
lines.en: You stepped back twice, and I struck three times.

lines.zh: 我伤你，是为了让你记住水底。
lines.en: I hurt you so you will remember the seabed.

lines.zh: 你活着离开，也算我赢了一半。
lines.en: If you leave alive, I still count it half a win.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过去，你的胸口自己疼起来。
lines.en: My hand passes through, and your chest aches on its own.

lines.zh: 这一下没有伤口，但你开始下沉。
lines.en: This blow leaves no wound, but you begin to sink.

lines.zh: 你心里一想起这片海，我就出现了。
lines.en: The moment you think of this sea, I appear.

lines.zh: 我没有刷怪蛋，是恐惧把我放进来的。
lines.en: I have no spawn egg; fear is what placed me here.

lines.zh: 黑暗够了，水深够了，我就站起来了。
lines.en: Enough dark, enough depth, and I stand up.

lines.zh: 我不从卵里出来，我从你的余光里出来。
lines.en: I do not hatch from an egg; I come from your side vision.

lines.zh: 你听过的那个传说，把我叫醒了。
lines.en: That legend you heard is what woke me up.

lines.zh: 我出生的时候没有声音，只有水位上涨。
lines.en: I was born without a sound, only the water rising.

lines.zh: 水里多了一块阴影，那就是我来了。
lines.en: A new shadow joins the water; that is my arrival.

lines.zh: 你在岸边站久了，我就会从浅滩上来。
lines.en: Stand on the shore too long and I climb out.

lines.zh: 我不是被生出来的，我是被想出来的。
lines.en: I was not born; I was thought into being.

lines.zh: 这片海每想起一次，就多一个我。
lines.en: Every time this sea remembers, one more of me exists.

lines.zh: 你在水下屏住呼吸时，我刚好到。
lines.en: You hold your breath under water, and I arrive right then.

lines.zh: 我出现时，海面会平一瞬。
lines.en: When I appear, the sea surface goes flat for an instant.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，问了我就会再来一个。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from; asking brings another.

lines.zh: 你回头看看，我已经在浅水里了。
lines.en: Turn around; I am already in the shallows.

lines.zh: 雷声还没停，我已经站在浪里。
lines.en: The thunder has not stopped, and I am already standing in the surf.

lines.zh: 风暴把一个名字吹进这片海。
lines.en: The storm blows a name into this stretch of sea.

lines.zh: 你的船灯照到水面，照出的影子是我。
lines.en: Your boat's lantern lights the water, and the shadow it shows is me.

lines.zh: 潮退的时候，我从湿沙里站起来。
lines.en: When the tide pulls back, I rise out of the wet sand.

lines.zh: 火燎过来，我的轮廓化成一团雾。
lines.en: Fire sweeps over me and my outline turns to mist.

lines.zh: 摔到海底，我散开又慢慢站起。
lines.en: I hit the seabed, scatter, and slowly stand again.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，水淹不死幻觉。
lines.en: I do not breathe; water cannot drown a hallucination.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散，声音却留在原处。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; the sound stays where I was.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在你身后的沙上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me and sticks in the sand.

lines.zh: 药水溅开，我的脸模糊了一瞬。
lines.en: Potion splashes and my face blurs for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，所以从没饿过。
lines.en: I eat nothing, so I have never once been hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮海面，我反而更清楚了。
lines.en: Lightning lights the sea, and I become clearer instead.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我却还在看着你。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, yet I still watch you.
